Name: Ex Works
Description: Buyer collects goods from seller's location

Name: Free Carrier
Description: Seller delivers to carrier or named place

Name: Carriage Paid To
Description: Seller pays carriage, risk transfers at handover to carrier

Name: Carriage and Insurance Paid To
Seller Pays: Carriage, insurance to destination, export customs
Description: Like CPT but seller also pays insurance

Name: Delivered at Place
Seller Pays: All transport to destination, export customs
Description: Seller delivers goods ready for unloading

Name: Free on Board
Description: Seller loads goods onto the ship

Name: Cost and Freight
Risk Transfer: When goods are on board at origin
Description: Seller pays freight, risk at loading

Name: Cost, Insurance and Freight
Risk Transfer: When goods are on board at origin
Description: Like CFR but seller also pays insurance
